name: dynamic-portfolio
description: A dynamic portfolio build with Muuri and Photoswipe.

paragraphs: A professional, high-performance image gallery featuring real-time filtering, smart search, and an immersive lightbox experience. Live Preview

This project is a dynamic portfolio designed for photographers, designers, and creatives. It combines the layout flexibility of Muuri with the powerful lightbox capabilities of PhotoSwipe, all wrapped in a responsive Bootstrap 5 container. The result is a fluid, interactive gallery that works seamlessly across desktop and mobile devices. This project is heavily inspired by the work of franciscopugh .
features: Dynamic Grid Layout: Powered by Muuri, providing smooth item transitions and automatic layout adjustments.
Real-Time Filtering: Instantly filter items by categories (Nature, City, Landscape, Computer).
Smart Search: Search through the gallery using keywords, titles, or tags.
